abilities.name: Group: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion
abilities.description: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
